svg.text: Battery, protection, motor supply (VBAT) and the single 5 V rail for the Uno, the ESP32-CAM and the sensors.
Drawn: ResQBot team · Date: 2026-10-18 · Resistors ¼ W 5 %
ENA/ENB jumpers removed: speed comes from the Uno (sheet 5).
5V-EN jumper ON; the module's +5V pin is not used.
1. Turn the LM2596 screw until OUT+ reads 5.0 V on a multimeter BEFORE connecting the Uno or any sensor.
2. F1 (3 A glass or blade fuse) goes in the + lead, close to the battery. The pack's BMS is a second layer.
3. Join all GNDs at one point near the L298N (star ground) so motor current does not upset the sensors.
4. Uploading to the Uno over USB: switch SW1 off and unplug the D0 wire (the ESP32-CAM link) first.
5. The L298N drops ~2 V: motors see ~5.5–6 V from the 7.4 V pack, which suits 6 V BO motors.
